A morning full of curious minds, proud smiles, happy chatter & a whole lot of learning! 

Our 2nd Display Day brought our community together to celebrate the wonderful work our learners have been exploring, creating and making over the past three months. 

From confidently sharing their learning to parents soaking it all in ... the space was buzzing with stories, conversations and little moments of pride.

And, of course… no Display Day is complete without some idli & vadas!!!

Adventure Day at Papagoya took our learners into the heart of Cubbon Park this month. 🌿

It was a morning of walking, climbing, spotting, listening and discovering,  from earthworms and millipedes beneath our feet to giant snails, barbets, parakeets and black kites all around us.

Learners explored colours in nature, took part in a scavenger hunt, and slowed down to notice the textures, sounds and tiny details we often walk past.

One of the highlights was a rock formation that looked just like a crocodile basking in the sun, perfect for a little climbing, imagination and wonder.

A big thank you to  agreenventurenaturewalks for guiding our learners through such a thoughtful and playful morning in nature. 💚

Adventure Day, the Papagoya way: explore, notice, wonder, play.

Playbook took learning beyond the room. 💛

As part of Playbook for Educators, our educators stepped out into Bengaluru with  localwalks.blr  Sriram for Streets That Talk Back — a walk through the city using stories, observation and curiosity to explore how place itself can become a classroom.

It was a chance to slow down, look a little closer, ask questions, notice what we usually pass by, and experience the city in a completely different way.

Because sometimes, the best learning happens when you step outside. ✨

A little glimpse from Playbook for Educators 2026.

What a day. 💛

Playbook for Families brought children, parents, grandparents and friends together for a full day of making, moving, imagining, discovering, laughing and playing.

From the Micro-School Learners’ Flea Market and glowing installations to stories, Capoeira, food theatre, hands-on workshops, music, conversations and so many little moments in between — every corner of Sabha had something happening.

Our Micro-School learners also turned their play into purpose, planning and running their own Flea Market, with the funds raised going to the liana_forest_school Liana and parinaamfoundation.

A huge thank you to all our facilitators, partners, performers, educators and the Papagoya team who helped bring the day to life.
